# Samarth Fire Protection System

> Fire protection, life-safety system maintenance and compliance support for buildings in Mumbai and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Maharashtra, India.

## Business identity
- Business name: Samarth Fire Protection System
- Founder / principal consultant named on the website: Sameer M. Kangutkar
- Maharashtra Fire Services agency licence shown on the website: MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35
- Published licence validity shown on the website: 14 January 2026 to 13 January 2028
- Office location: Malad East, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Primary phone / WhatsApp: +91 99671 01472
- Email: samarthfireprotectionsystem@gmail.com
- Website: https://samarthfire.in/

## Services described on this website
- Fire-fighting systems, hydrants, wet risers, hose reels and sprinklers
- Fire pumps, pump-room maintenance and system testing
- Fire detection, alarm panels and fault investigation
- Portable fire extinguishers, servicing and hydrostatic testing
- Passive fire protection, fire doors and fire stopping
- Building fire-safety audits and defect reports
- Form A / Form B documentation and compliance support
- Housing-society fire drills and safety awareness training

## Accuracy and safety notes
- Service availability, licence scope and site-specific suitability must be confirmed directly with the business and the relevant authority.
- Form A, Form B and Fire NOC / fire approval are different documents and must not be used interchangeably.
- Fire-system pressure, inspection intervals and acceptance criteria depend on the building design, equipment, applicable standards and current authority directions.
- This file is a factual website index, not a legal document, certification, emergency procedure or substitute for a site inspection.
